newFactsLearned.fact: All patches defined in the remediation plan were successfully applied to the pom.xml file, as confirmed by the patch application proof.
The Maven build failed immediately after the application of patches, indicating an incompatibility introduced by one or more of the updated dependencies.
The dependency 'org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-core' was specifically targeted for a downgrade from version '2.14.1' to '2.12.3'. This downgrade could be a contributing factor to the build failure.

recommendedFocusForPlanner: Investigate the specific root cause of the Maven build failure. Access to the full build log would be critical for this analysis.
Prioritize the analysis of the `log4j-core` downgrade (2.14.1 to 2.12.3) as a potential source of incompatibility, then review other updated dependencies.
Consider reverting individual patches or combinations of patches to isolate the problematic dependency update that causes the build failure.
If identifying a compatible version proves difficult, or if the fix requires significant architectural changes, consider re-classifying affected vulnerabilities for manual review.

whatChanged.summary: All planned dependency version updates were successfully applied to pom.xml.
